title: Choose the Create assessment Campaign station
question: Shipboard Terminal stays. The roll seated a source berth rack inside the management record — not the current stacked dropdowns. Lock a composition, steer, or re-roll. Alphabet storm, variable-font specimen, and elbow-panel console wait in the re-roll pool.

options.label: Berth rack
options.lineage: Source board on a working ship: ten required bindings occupy visible berths
options.thesis: Name the Campaign on a plaque; the ten required sources sit as etched berths you inspect and bind, then Create.
options.viewport: Command strip and gangway stay. Operate head is Create assessment Campaign, Activities back, and form/type microlabels. A wide notched plate fills the record: title nameplate, then a visible 5-by-2 berth grid of product-named sources with short revision codes and eligibility marks; dashed slack for a missing required category. Amber Create stays in the reserved foot.
options.risk: Ten cells still read as a parts bin if labels stay snake_case or revisions stay raw UUIDs.

raised.raise: The Campaign title is the one word that comes into existence; berths are the landscape it names, not a second equal form.
A missing required category is a slack dashed berth, never an omitted row.
Title at display scale, source labels at instrument micro; hierarchy by scale contrast alone.
Berths sit on an etched division grid; each cell is one source channel.
The construction grid stays visible; sources occupy cells, they are not a stacked form.
Each berth carries a short revision code cluster, not a prose sentence.

options.label: Commissioning plate
options.lineage: Lab Campaign Configuration ceremony plate, seated as the create record
options.thesis: Create is one wide ceremony plate: identity first, then the signed source set, then a monument Create.
options.viewport: Same chrome. A wide notched ceremony plate fills the record, not a dialog. Form/type as a chase. Campaign title at monument scale. Agent and Harness as two full selects; the other eight bindings as a compact signed revision strip. Amber Create in the ceremony foot.
options.case: Strongest when the administrator should feel a Campaign coming into existence, then continue to Setup.
options.risk: Reads as a parked modal, or as Setup-lite, if the plate floats or the strip hides exact revisions.

options.label: Dock ledger
options.lineage: Reviewer split bay adapted to commissioning: identity facing the source manifest
options.thesis: Identity and source manifest are facing pages, so Create never hides below the source wall.
options.viewport: Operate head with back and title. Start column: form/type, Campaign title, and the Create key. Main column: ten readable source rows (object, name, revision, eligibility), each a select. Narrow stacks identity then manifest with Create sticky.
options.case: Holds when all ten revisions must stay inspectable without scrolling the primary action away.
options.risk: The left column feels empty until a title is typed, and can read as a reviewer console for a create task.

options.label: Construction grid
options.lineage: Wim Crouwel gridded type specimen, fused as a visible cell armature
options.thesis: Letterforms and sources assemble from the same visible construction grid.
options.viewport: Faint construction hairlines over the record; the title occupies giant cells; sources fill the remaining cells.
options.case: Holds clarity of required cells; loses audience — administrators are not poster makers. The visible cell grid was kept.
options.kept: The construction grid stays visible; sources occupy cells, they are not a stacked form.
options.risk: A type-specimen poster on a fairness binding task.

options.label: Channel graticule
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope signal bench, fused as ten source channels
options.thesis: Each required source is a channel on one etched graticule.
options.viewport: A ten-division graticule where each division is a source channel with a revision readout.
options.case: Loses as a whole station: an oscilloscope watches signals over time, it does not bind discrete revisions. Channel divisions were kept.
options.kept: Berths sit on an etched division grid; each cell is one source channel.
options.risk: Turns commissioning into a live waveform monitor.

options.label: Load members
options.lineage: Tensegrity breathing column, fused as required source members
options.thesis: The Campaign stands only when every required source is in tension.
options.viewport: A force diagram of ten members; slack members are unbound categories.
options.case: Loses audience: administrators are not structural engineers. Slack-versus-locked was kept.
options.kept: A missing required category is a slack dashed berth, never an omitted row.
options.risk: A sculpture metaphor on a create form.
